_doc: A 40 x 20 mm slotted aluminium profile as sold unbranded ("2040, 20x40 slot 6, B-type"): a stand-in until the bar in hand is measured (cad measure, or a caliper and cad rules draft profile). Its outline is one named seller's CAD outline (KJN), its section figures and alloy another's catalogue (Dold Mechatronik), and every figure is community. Far-East "2040" stock differs as the 2020 does. Described lying flat, so inertia_x is the smaller second moment. The drawn outline leaves out the notches round each bore, the steps at the mouths and the V grooves.
